_note: Which earlier tax years' retirement deductions form the B of RET-LEAVE-ENCASHMENT-AGGREGATE's A − B: both leave encashment entries — S2 s.19(2)(f), on "any payment on account of cash equivalent of leave salary", "B = the aggregate amount of payment or payments which was received in any one or more earlier tax years and allowed as an exemption or a deduction" (quoted in RET-LEAVE-ENCASHMENT-AGGREGATE's note), which names no entry of s.19(1) Table, so a Government employee's (Sl. 13) and any other employee's (Sl. 14) leave salary both count (owner's reading, D-339 C3a). TY 2025-26: 1961 s.10(10AA)(ii) provisos, "to the same effect" as that note records. Reached by the payment's entry (retirement.entry) and each earlier entry the ledger holds (retirement.earlier.entry). The row states the reach only; provisions, introduction and provenance are RET-LEAVE-ENCASHMENT-AGGREGATE's (W-155c1). Every regime.
